column1: 22169§involve§ɪnˈvɒlv§No city can be simply a port but must be involved in a variety of other activities.§没有哪个城市能够单纯作为港口，它必然还**含有**其他多种功能。§
22170§dairy§ˈdeəri§Try using low-lactose dairy foods, such as yogurt, instead of milk.§尝试用一些低乳的**奶制品**，如酸奶，来代替牛奶。§
22171§confirm§kənˈfɜːm§If a prediction based on a hypothesis is fulfilled, then the hypothesis is confirmed.§如果基于某一假设的预测得到实现，那么该假设就被**证实**是正确的。§改例句：英文句中的中文逗号改为英文逗号
22172§hinge§hɪndʒ§The two metal tubes joined at a hinge at one end.§这两根金属管的末端连接在一个**铰链**上。§
22173§subsidise§ˈsʌbsɪdaɪz§They actually subsidise the exploitation and consumption of natural resources.§他们实际上为自然资源的开发和消费提供**资助**。§
22174§stain§steɪn§The ink stained his shirt blue.§墨水给他的衬衫**染上**了蓝色。§
22175§unload§ˌʌnˈləʊd§Loading and unloading costs can be minimised by refining raw materials or turning them into finished goods.§可以通过对原材料进行加工或将其制成成品来将它们的装**卸**成本降至最低。§
22176§conversion§kənˈvɜːʃn§Clean coal is another avenue for improving fuel conversion efficiency.§洁净煤是提高燃烧**转换**效率的另一种途径。§
22177§irrelevant§ɪˈreləvənt§What you wrote is almost irrelevant to the topic.§你写的文章和主题几乎**无关**。§
22178§thrill§θrɪl§The traveller thrilled us with his stories of adventure.§这位旅行者的冒险经历令我们**激动不已**。§
22179§trial§ˈtraɪəl§The trial lasted for three days.§**审讯**持续了三天。§
22180§extol§ɪkˈstəʊl§Weld extolled Kerry's debate skills, saying he has "the speed of a welter-weight."§韦尔德**称赞**了克里的辩论技巧，说他有着“次中量级拳击手的速度”。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22181§albeit§ˌɔːlˈbiːɪt§A program for low-carbon energy finally got through this month, albeit in substantially scaled-down form.§一项低碳能源的计划本月最终获得通过，**尽管**其规模大大缩小。§
22182§obstacle§ˈɒbstəkl§An obstacle, setback or delay means only one thing: it's not time for your goal to be completed yet.§一个**障碍**、挫败或延迟只意味着一件事：现在还不是你实现目标的时候。§
22183§meagre§ˈmiːgə(r)§His meagre salary couldn't afford the basic consumption in the time of inflation.§通货膨胀期间，他那点**可怜巴巴**的工资不足以维持最基本的开销。§

22184§precipitation§prɪˌsɪpɪˈteɪʃn§According to the statistics released by the Office of State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters, precipitation in many parts of central China has been 50 to 80 percent above normal.§国家防汛抗旱总指挥部办公室公布的数据显示，华中很多地区的**降水量**比同期正常水平高了50%~80%。§改例句：表示「数据」应为复数 statistics
22185§precarious§prɪˈkeəriəs§The peninsula's peace will face a precarious situation if the negotiation breaks down.§如果谈判破裂，半岛的和平将面临**岌岌可危**的局面。§
22186§autonomy§ɔːˈtɒnəmi§Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.§每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的**自主权**。§

22187§credibility§ˌkredəˈbɪləti§Credibility is an essential characteristic that is built on the elements of integrity, reliability, veracity, competence and commitment.§**诚信**是一个重要的品质，是建立在正直、可靠、诚实、能力和承诺的基础之上的。§

22188§onslaught§ˈɒnslɔːt§The onslaught of media attention has brought unnecessary distraction to the boxer who should focus exclusively on his competition.§媒体**铺天盖地**的关注使这个拳击手很分心，他本应该只专注于比赛的。§改译文：原译「过分」没译出 onslaught（猛烈的一大波），改成「铺天盖地」

22189§curtail§kɜːˈteɪl§The new constitution imposed dogmatic property rules which had severely curtailed people's interest.§新宪法强制推行专断财产法，严重**削减**了民众利益。§改例句：复数 rules 前不能用 a，删去 a；改译文：curtail 是「削减，限制」，原译「损害」改成「削减」
22190§correlation§ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃn§There's a high correlation between trace element selenium insufficiency and functional disease.§微量元素硒不足和官能性疾病有着紧密的**联系**。§改例句：形容词 insufficient 不能作名词，改为 insufficiency
22191§afflicting§əˈflɪktɪŋ§Violent crime is only one of the maladies afflicting modern society.§暴力犯罪仅仅是**困扰**现代社会的严重问题之一。§
22192§simulation§ˌsɪmjuˈleɪʃn§The manager was beforehand with a computer simulation of likely sales performance in advance of the Spring Festival.§经理在春节来临前就事先用计算机**模拟**出了可能的销售业绩。§

22193§incongruous§ɪnˈkɒŋɡruəs§As incongruous as it may sound, the little frog with big eyes has no lungs and gets all the oxygen it needs through its skin.§听起来可能**不可思议**的是，这种身材小巧、眼睛大大的蛙类居然没有肺，所需氧气均要靠皮肤来获得。§

22194§remuneration§rɪˌmjuːnəˈreɪʃn§To meet the requirements of public interest, the investment of the investors could be expropriated in compliance with legal procedure with a due remuneration.§为了满足公共利益的需求，可以依照法律程序没收投资者的投资，并给予相应的**报酬**。§改例句：in comply with 语法错，应为 in compliance with

22195§intermix§ˌɪntəˈmɪks§In an insignificant basis of reality, the imagination spins, weaving new patterns and intermixing with memories, experience, free fancies, incongruities and improvisations.§在微不足道的现实中，想象力织就着新的世界，**混合**着记忆、经历、自由幻想、怪异及随想。§

22196§paramount§ˈpærəmaʊnt§We believed that it is of paramount importance to disseminate knowledge, so that patient care will continue to improve across Europe and beyond.§我们相信传播知识是**最重要**的，以使欧洲及其他地方的患者护理得到持续改善。§改例句：Europe 前不加冠词，删去 the
22197§hypnotic§hɪpˈnɒtɪk§Western people believed that being hypnotic could help people remember something happening in life.§西方人相信，**催眠**可以帮助人们记起生活中发生的一些事。§
22198§suffice§səˈfaɪs§No more boring lectures, painful seminars or tiring presentations. A few sentences will suffice.§没有枯燥的说教、痛苦的研讨会或令人厌倦的演讲，几句话就**够**了。§
22199§technician§tekˈnɪʃn§This looseness in molecular structure of glass allows technicians to tailor it to whatever they need.§玻璃松散的分子结构使**技术人员**可以按照自己的需求对其进行加工。§
22200§apart§əˈpɑːt§Apart from the Second World War period, the Winter Olympics were held every four years.§**除了**第二次世界大战期间，冬奥会每四年举行一次。§
22201§mainstream§ˈmeɪnstriːm§His radical views place him outside the mainstream of American politics.§他的激进观点使他脱离了美国政治的**主流**。§
22202§flush§flʌʃ§You can flush a wound with iodine to prevent the infection.§可以用碘酒**冲洗**伤口，以防止感染。§
22203§stir§stɜː(r)§You'd better give the coffee a stir before you drink it.§喝咖啡之前最好先**搅拌**一下。§
22204§odd§ɒd§We are attracted by the odd behavior of the boy.§男孩**古怪**的行为吸引了我们。§

22205§inject§ɪnˈdʒekt§By injecting lime into the land around the water and neutralizing the effects of acid, scientists have created conditions in which fish can survive.§通过对水域周围的土地**注入**石灰，中和当地的酸性效应，科学家已经创造出能让鱼存活的环境。§
22206§demand§dɪˈmɑːnd§Tall buildings were constructed to help meet the demand for more economical use of land.§高层建筑的建造是为了满足节约用地的**需求**。§
22207§unsatisfactory§ˌʌnˌsætɪsˈfæktəri§Reception of television programmes is unsatisfactory here.§这个地区电视节目的接收情况**不能令人满意**。§
22208§excursion§ɪkˈskɜːʃn§Our family took a two-week excursion to France.§我们一家人去法国**旅行**了两周。§
22209§grid§grɪd§New York is laid out on a grid, which makes it easier to find your way around.§纽约市的布局呈**网格**状，因此你不容易迷路。§改译文：原译「十分整齐」没有译出 grid（格子），改为「呈网格状」
22210§controversial§ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃl§The appearance of individual buildings is often controversial.§私人建筑的外观常常会引起**争议**。§
22211§wagon§ˈwægən§The horses were harnessed and hooked to the wagon.§这些马被装上挽具，套到**马车**上。§
22212§reputation§ˌrepjuˈteɪʃn§The college has already established a national reputation for its excellence.§该校凭借着自己的卓越表现已经**享誉**全国。§
22213§tag§tæg§If you are going to see the film, would you mind if I tag along?§你要是去看电影，我也**跟着**去行吗？§
22214§dizzy§ˈdɪzi§He is dizzy and confused and does not want to be here.§他感到**眩晕**迷惑，不想待在这儿。§
22215§immune§ɪˈmjuːn§The viruses stimulated the immune system.§病毒刺激了**免疫**系统。§
22216§carve§kɑːv§At the family dinner, my grandfather always carves the roast turkey into thin slices for everyone at the table.§家庭聚餐时，爷爷总是把烤火鸡**切**成薄片，分给桌上的每个人。§补例句
22217§geology§dʒiˈɒlədʒi§The geology varies a good deal from region to region even in one country.§即使是在同一个国家，不同地区的**地况**也极为不同。§
22218§directory§dəˈrektəri§For our addresses, just check in your local telephone directory.§你可以在当地的电话**簿**中找到我们的地址。§
22219§vital§ˈvaɪtl§The Department has a vital role to play in providing information to visitors and scholars.§该部门在为来访者及学者提供信息方面发挥着**极其重要**的作用。§

22220§droplet§ˈdrɒplət§Study of atmospheric particles formed from the explosion showed that droplets of sulphuric acid, acting as a screen between the Sun and the Earth's surface, caused a distinct drop in temperature.§对爆炸后形成的大气颗粒的研究显示，硫酸**小液滴**在太阳与地球表面之间形成了一层屏障，使气温明显降低。§改译文：droplet 是「小液滴」，原译「微粒」改成「小液滴」
22221§reveal§rɪˈviːl§The Human Genome Project will reveal a new human anatomy—the complete genetic blueprint for a human being.§人类基因工程将**揭开**人类解剖学的新篇章——描绘完整的人类基因蓝图。§改译文：原译「开启」不是 reveal（揭示）的意思，改为「揭开」
22222§visible§ˈvɪzəbl§Comets are only normally visible in the immediate vicinity of the sun.§彗星只有在最接近太阳时才**可见**。§
22223§conference§ˈkɒnfərəns§I'm going to a conference in London.§我要去伦敦参加一个**会议**。§
22224§cholesterol§kəˈlestərɒl§Ostrich meat is much lower in fat and cholesterol than beef.§鸵鸟肉中的脂肪和**胆固醇**含量比牛肉中的低很多。§
22225§calcium§ˈkælsiəm§Calcium is essential for developing healthy bones.§**钙**对骨骼的健康生长至关重要。§
22226§construct§kənˈstrʌkt§This anticipation is constructed through films, TV and literature.§这一预想通过电影、电视和文学得以**构思**成形。§
22227§interval§ˈɪntəvl§The discussion was so prolonged and exhausting that at intervals the speakers stopped for refreshment.§讨论冗长又使人疲倦，以至于发言人**不时**要停下来休息。§
22228§advent§ˈædvent§Sea ports have been transformed by the advent of powered vessels, whose size and draught have increased.§配有引擎的货船体积更加庞大，可以装载更多货物，它们的**出现**改变了海港原有的样子。§
22229§aggressiveness§əˈɡresɪvnəs§The message behind a crushing handshake is aggressiveness and a desire to compete.§在和他人握手时如果很用力，它传达的信息是**争斗**或想和对方竞争。§
22230§category§ˈkætəgəri§After the final interview, potential recruits were divided into three categories.§经过最后的面试，可能入选的新成员被分成三**类**。§
22231§fault§fɔːlt§Any fault should be reported to the local fault repair service.§出现任何**问题**都应报知当地的维修中心。§
22232§confusion§kənˈfjuːʒn§This medicine may cause hair loss, depression or confusion, and yellowing of skin or eyes.§服用该药有可能导致脱发、精神抑郁或**神志不清**，还可能致使肤色或眼睛发黄。§改例句：英文句中的中文逗号改为英文逗号
22233§wrinkle§ˈrɪŋkl§From where we are in the orchestra, you can see every wrinkle on her face.§从我们所在的剧院位置，你可以看到她脸上的每一条**皱纹**。§
22234§huddle§ˈhʌdl§There is a huddle of people around the injured man.§一群人**聚**在伤者周围。§
22235§clash§klæʃ§In the clash between environmentalists and developers, the Native Americans have suffered the most.§在环境保护主义者和开发者之间的**冲突**中，美洲原住民受到的伤害最大。§
22236§briefly§ˈbriːfli§He paused briefly before continuing.§他停了**片刻**又继续进行。§
22237§commodity§kəˈmɒdəti§Nowadays, the airlines are treating their seats like a commodity.§现在，航空公司把客机的席位看作是一种**商品**（进行出售）。§
